name: Milind Patel
title: Web Development Manager
summary: Web Development Manager and hands-on senior full-stack engineer with 10+ years of experience (since 2015) designing, building, and shipping secure web applications on .NET, Angular, React, and Microsoft SQL Server across Azure and AWS. Still close to the code every day — from ASP.NET Core Web APIs and T-SQL tuning to Angular/React front ends, release engineering, and CI/CD — while leading a development team through solution design, PR reviews, and delivery. Owns PCI DSS compliance across Rexall's Magento, .NET, and React applications, and champions AI-assisted engineering with Claude and prompt engineering to ship faster without compromising quality.

experience.title: Web Development Manager
bullets: Lead engineering delivery for a team of developers — driving solution design, PR and code reviews, sprint planning and backlog grooming with Product, and mentoring engineers on clean architecture and secure coding.

Stay hands-on in the codebase, building and extending ASP.NET Core Web APIs and Angular/React front ends on MS SQL Server, applying Dependency Injection, layered architecture, and SOLID principles to keep services testable and maintainable.

Own PCI DSS compliance across Rexall's Magento e-commerce sites, .NET applications, and React applications — running audits end to end, compiling evidence with auditors and internal teams, remediating vulnerability-scan findings (OWASP Top 10 issues such as XSS, injection, and insecure configuration), and enforcing secure-coding standards in code review.

Introduced AI-assisted development with Claude, Claude Code, and prompt engineering — standardizing prompts for code generation, unit-test scaffolding, PR summaries, and technical documentation to shorten turnaround on routine engineering work.
Harden and evolve a security-confidential Azure environment alongside the operations team — configuring Azure and AWS components, secrets and role-based access, and remediation best practices.

Run release engineering for multiple ASP.NET C# applications — branching and code-merge strategy, code drops and hotfix patches, and gated promotions from pre-production to production, with impact assessment and rollback planning alongside external teams and stakeholders.

Translate functional requirements into technical designs — data models, API contracts, and T-SQL stored procedures — on the latest .NET with SQL Server, and tune slow queries through indexing and execution-plan analysis.

experience.title: Lead Developer
bullets: Built and maintained full-stack features across Rexall's ASP.NET Core and ASP.NET Framework applications with Angular 12 and React 18 front ends, delivering RESTful APIs, reusable UI components, and responsive pages.
Designed T-SQL stored procedures, views, and indexes in MS SQL Server, and optimized long-running queries using execution plans to improve page-load and reporting performance.

Managed PCI DSS compliance across the Magento e-commerce sites, ASP.NET C# applications, and React applications — coordinating audits, gathering evidence, remediating audit and vulnerability-scan findings, and applying PCI secure-coding practices in day-to-day development.

Streamlined the implementation of a security-confidential Azure cloud environment with the operations team, provisioning and configuring Azure and AWS components and introducing remediation best practices.

Owned code-merge and release work across multiple ASP.NET C# applications — resolving merge conflicts, preparing code drops and patches for pre-production and production within secure systems, and coordinating change impact with external teams.
Built and maintained Azure DevOps build and release pipelines, bringing consistent, repeatable deployments to the team's applications.
Served as the team's technical go-to — debugging production issues across UI, API, and database layers, reviewing pull requests, and leading project risk and issue management.

experience.title: .NET Developer
bullets: Designed and developed full-stack web applications with Angular 11 and .NET 5 Web APIs, working within an Agile team across every phase of the SDLC.
Built a RabbitMQ-based integration — message consumers plus scheduled SQL jobs that process queued events and generate downstream data — decoupling upstream systems from reporting workloads.
Implemented system-wide audit logging with SQL triggers and stored procedures that capture before/after record changes for traceability and support.
Upgraded and extended Telerik Kendo UI grids, forms, and charts in Angular, replacing custom controls so the team could focus on value-generating features.
Set up and configured Microsoft Azure cloud components and Azure DevOps pipelines for development, test, and production environments.

experience.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Partnered with Product Owners and Scrum Masters to translate user stories into automated process flows built in the AWD BPM tool.
Built rule-driven document-filtering automation using XML logic and Mobius Document Direct, removing manual document-handling steps.
Developed ASP.NET C# user interfaces for custom internal applications on a modern .NET backend.
Wrote parameterized stored procedures powering reporting and data retrieval across SQL Server and Oracle.
Built reusable SSIS ETL packages to ingest flat-file, Excel, and XML sources into SQL Server, plus DTS import/export routines delivering SQL Server data to client-side destinations.

experience.title: Software Developer
bullets: Built Angular front ends backed by ASP.NET Core Web APIs for internal business-process applications.
Designed and automated business processes in IBM BPM 8.5 — developing Business Process Definitions (BPDs) from requirements and deploying them to test environments.
Captured data requirements with business analysts through process blueprints and Visio diagrams.
Validated BPDs with positive and negative test cases, comparing expected and actual results through manual and automated testing.

experience.title: Senior Software Developer
bullets: Designed and built a School ERP platform on ASP.NET MVC, ASP.NET Core Web API, Angular, and SQL Server that automated school back-office workflows and streamlined resource planning.
Designed RESTful APIs, SQL Server schemas, and stored procedures, and built responsive Bootstrap UIs across the application.
Worked directly with clients to turn business requirements into scalable solutions, owning scope definition, estimation, planning, and tracking for API and application development.
Mentored junior developers through code reviews and pairing, establishing coding standards across design, coding, testing, and debugging.
